Coconut water ` [Highlight start] can help ease hangover symptoms by rehydrating your body and replenishing electrolytes like potassium and magnesium [Highlight end] ` , though it is not a true cure for a hangover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX0ARDRP_GebOkU0T7dZOyK2QX6gg_2AbKHzzEmx6C0BiaCJ6sPTFHUJWI4DL7RfHecPVMw7WgldazpBVctqq_6B_4YpV72QQgqlvNhS3dgnfD6hjK-HLmY97xkjaeO2rGnsLWcNG320QaJsU8lyazeQSlbrmehQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX808B7Xi1epxietg16Rbfrp0Na4PU8zeMf57cUpIGtuVw_MzTgHvsHHQbmg_fcs6SbIatnr2ruljWFNFSmhLK2rzj9H4Fn59kxI1t3euCN8uEp4a7FpMTyi7OzIO5Kpvz8VphX8Z5vn9IBhS5UK4WeWCnru0XwOfvx6Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXcD1Z9dUkBaIfLxUwVYfKWzgA5bbKgUCP46zFgzbuF1j-JVBdz00BFlT7H7BJ0a4ZbuH3kCA5GoX59ikRW5HfaA3tZlMeX4eFsD026_cfeZoSLuqTuqM8sFn93MgcKxRWguPxf1hPr-vXDIyNd7U)

### Why It Helps

- **Rehydration:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic, flushing out fluids and leaving you dehydrated. Coconut water is about 94% water and helps restore lost fluids.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX0ARDRP_GebOkU0T7dZOyK2QX6gg_2AbKHzzEmx6C0BiaCJ6sPTFHUJWI4DL7RfHecPVMw7WgldazpBVctqq_6B_4YpV72QQgqlvNhS3dgnfD6hjK-HLmY97xkjaeO2rGnsLWcNG320QaJsU8lyazeQSlbrmehQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF19QSRcLGWxvah_dqMwJkhXetXUv3gusZnVM8JnTKTTCzSS3mb4PeXu1ZoOtlYJl5rrTlfjXTr77iZy9h8qu7d65gaYO7fjbyZ2QIxpQBDXqYxXr2qb7RU3jdN-i5u6yY4KUQVd6M2lGZ6R3-RAvZkGdRENF1_yt3VXI_LES9QwHRs0tLUPILoMQ)
- **Electrolytes:** It provides potassium and magnesium, which support fluid balance, muscle and nerve function, and energy—helping ease headaches, fatigue, and nausea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXcD1Z9dUkBaIfLxUwVYfKWzgA5bbKgUCP46zFgzbuF1j-JVBdz00BFlT7H7BJ0a4ZbuH3kCA5GoX59ikRW5HfaA3tZlMeX4eFsD026_cfeZoSLuqTuqM8sFn93MgcKxRWguPxf1hPr-vXDIyNd7U)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX0ARDRP_GebOkU0T7dZOyK2QX6gg_2AbKHzzEmx6C0BiaCJ6sPTFHUJWI4DL7RfHecPVMw7WgldazpBVctqq_6B_4YpV72QQgqlvNhS3dgnfD6hjK-HLmY97xkjaeO2rGnsLWcNG320QaJsU8lyazeQSlbrmehQ)
- **Gentle on the stomach:** Unlike heavy or sugary drinks, pure coconut water is light and naturally contains electrolytes without added caffeine or excess sugar.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX808B7Xi1epxietg16Rbfrp0Na4PU8zeMf57cUpIGtuVw_MzTgHvsHHQbmg_fcs6SbIatnr2ruljWFNFSmhLK2rzj9H4Fn59kxI1t3euCN8uEp4a7FpMTyi7OzIO5Kpvz8VphX8Z5vn9IBhS5UK4WeWCnru0XwOfvx6Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF19QSRcLGWxvah_dqMwJkhXetXUv3gusZnVM8JnTKTTCzSS3mb4PeXu1ZoOtlYJl5rrTlfjXTr77iZy9h8qu7d65gaYO7fjbyZ2QIxpQBDXqYxXr2qb7RU3jdN-i5u6yY4KUQVd6M2lGZ6R3-RAvZkGdRENF1_yt3VXI_LES9QwHRs0tLUPILoMQ)

### Limits & Tips

- **No true cure:** Only time allows your body to fully clear alcohol and its byproducts, so coconut water relieves symptoms rather than curing the hangover outright.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX0ARDRP_GebOkU0T7dZOyK2QX6gg_2AbKHzzEmx6C0BiaCJ6sPTFHUJWI4DL7RfHecPVMw7WgldazpBVctqq_6B_4YpV72QQgqlvNhS3dgnfD6hjK-HLmY97xkjaeO2rGnsLWcNG320QaJsU8lyazeQSlbrmehQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF19QSRcLGWxvah_dqMwJkhXetXUv3gusZnVM8JnTKTTCzSS3mb4PeXu1ZoOtlYJl5rrTlfjXTr77iZy9h8qu7d65gaYO7fjbyZ2QIxpQBDXqYxXr2qb7RU3jdN-i5u6yY4KUQVd6M2lGZ6R3-RAvZkGdRENF1_yt3VXI_LES9QwHRs0tLUPILoMQ)
- **Choose 100% pure:** Look for unsweetened coconut water without added sugars or artificial ingredients.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX808B7Xi1epxietg16Rbfrp0Na4PU8zeMf57cUpIGtuVw_MzTgHvsHHQbmg_fcs6SbIatnr2ruljWFNFSmhLK2rzj9H4Fn59kxI1t3euCN8uEp4a7FpMTyi7OzIO5Kpvz8VphX8Z5vn9IBhS5UK4WeWCnru0XwOfvx6Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXcD1Z9dUkBaIfLxUwVYfKWzgA5bbKgUCP46zFgzbuF1j-JVBdz00BFlT7H7BJ0a4ZbuH3kCA5GoX59ikRW5HfaA3tZlMeX4eFsD026_cfeZoSLuqTuqM8sFn93MgcKxRWguPxf1hPr-vXDIyNd7U)
- **Best timing:** Sip it before bed, between alcoholic drinks, or first thing in the morning alongside plain water and food. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF19QuwYO2VVE0uatvwq41TpjF8Q96cANzg2l7DeCTv3RCxGEo1fiCEw0ooEh1xGNZECBPDVgtmd9hefSq0aoNkjbH4hXttT8ctA17krr0qjszscf5wbBObmSxa5d5hrV7WiXV_m-q6o5yaY8hxr9doqXamZWkKVq1drxYwNNfPh6fE9q0mzghZuYLu9MohuZn81VI) agree that it helps relieve and prevent hangover symptoms as a natural alternative to sports drinks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX808B7Xi1epxietg16Rbfrp0Na4PU8zeMf57cUpIGtuVw_MzTgHvsHHQbmg_fcs6SbIatnr2ruljWFNFSmhLK2rzj9H4Fn59kxI1t3euCN8uEp4a7FpMTyi7OzIO5Kpvz8VphX8Z5vn9IBhS5UK4WeWCnru0XwOfvx6Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF19QSRcLGWxvah_dqMwJkhXetXUv3gusZnVM8JnTKTTCzSS3mb4PeXu1ZoOtlYJl5rrTlfjXTr77iZy9h8qu7d65gaYO7fjbyZ2QIxpQBDXqYxXr2qb7RU3jdN-i5u6yY4KUQVd6M2lGZ6R3-RAvZkGdRENF1_yt3VXI_LES9QwHRs0tLUPILoMQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXE6u2B-XhxRZoTXvv5b3-m9C36qNmI6t3ANc5ttVA8T3j_pbS_qNAIkvepX3QEsGe8SLhm6f6RoDJePM5jsdKNJYFvUFDNj_DnR2Bzps6CxzZTYcJkltfTr4z_5cVOggTmQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF19QuwYO2VVE0uatvwq41TpjF8Q96cANzg2l7DeCTv3RCxGEo1fiCEw0ooEh1xGNZECBPDVgtmd9hefSq0aoNkjbH4hXttT8ctA17krr0qjszscf5wbBObmSxa5d5hrV7WiXV_m-q6o5yaY8hxr9doqXamZWkKVq1drxYwNNfPh6fE9q0mzghZuYLu9MohuZn81VI)
